content: Standard UAE visit visa checklist: passport valid for at least 6 months, one passport-size photograph, CNIC copy (for Pakistani nationals), confirmed return air ticket, and hotel booking or sponsor details. Processing normally takes 3-5 working days after document submission. Approval is decided solely by UAE immigration authorities.

UK visit visa applications generally require a valid passport, financial statements for the last 6 months, proof of accommodation, travel itinerary, and an online application form (VAF). Biometric appointment is mandatory. Processing time is typically 15-20 working days, though this can vary by season.

Turkey visit visa requirements: passport copy, photograph, confirmed hotel booking, return ticket, and bank statement. Many nationalities can also apply for an e-Visa online. Processing for the e-Visa is usually completed within 24-48 hours.

To request a fare, customers should share: departure city, destination city, preferred travel dates, number of passengers, and travel class (economy/business). Fares are subject to airline availability and can change until the ticket is issued.

Baggage allowance depends on the airline and fare type booked. Typical economy allowance is 20-30kg for checked baggage and 7kg for cabin baggage. Customers should confirm exact limits with the airline at the time of booking, as policies vary.

The 5-night Thailand family package includes return flights, 4-star hotel accommodation, daily breakfast, airport transfers, and one city tour. It does not include visa fees, travel insurance, or optional excursions. Prices vary by season and must be confirmed at booking time.

Standard travel insurance plans typically cover emergency medical expenses, trip cancellation, lost baggage, and flight delays. Pre-existing medical conditions and high-risk activities are usually excluded unless a rider is purchased. Exact coverage and premium depend on destination, duration, and traveler age.
Travel insurance with a minimum coverage of EUR 30,000 for medical emergencies is mandatory for Schengen visa applications. The policy must be valid for the entire duration of the intended stay.
Office hours are Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM. The office is closed on Sundays and public holidays. Customers can also reach the support team via WhatsApp during office hours.

Accepted payment methods include bank transfer, major debit/credit cards, and cash at the office. Full payment is generally required before ticket issuance or visa file submission, unless a partial-advance arrangement has been agreed with the consultant.

The 4-night Dubai package includes return flights, 4-star hotel accommodation, daily breakfast, airport transfers, and a desert safari with BBQ dinner. Visa fees, travel insurance, and Burj Khalifa tickets are not included. Prices vary by season and hotel category.

The 7-night Istanbul & Cappadocia package includes return flights, 4-star hotels in both cities, daily breakfast, one domestic flight between cities, and a guided Old City tour. Hot air balloon rides in Cappadocia are optional and charged separately.

The 6-night Kuala Lumpur & Genting Highlands family package includes return flights, 4-star hotel stays, daily breakfast, airport transfers, and one day pass to Genting theme park. Meals other than breakfast, and visa fees, are not included.

Standard Umrah packages include return flights, hotel accommodation near Haram in Makkah and Madinah, ground transport between cities, and visa processing assistance. Ziyarat tours and additional hotel nights can be added at extra cost. Package prices vary by hotel distance and season, especially during Ramadan.

The 5-night Azerbaijan honeymoon package includes return flights, boutique hotel stay in Baku, daily breakfast, a Gabala day tour, and airport transfers. Visa on arrival is available for many nationalities; insurance and optional excursions are not included in the base price.

All advertised tour packages can be customized for extra nights, upgraded hotel category, added excursions, or different departure cities. Customers should share their preferred dates, number of travelers, and budget range so a consultant can prepare a tailored quotation.

Schengen visit visa requirements include a valid passport, completed application form, travel insurance with EUR 30,000 medical coverage, confirmed flight and hotel bookings, and financial statements for the last 6 months. Biometric appointment at the relevant embassy/consulate is mandatory. Processing typically takes 15 working days.

Thailand visit visa/e-Visa requirements include a passport valid for 6 months, passport photo, confirmed hotel booking, return ticket, and proof of sufficient funds. Many nationalities can apply for an e-Visa online, typically processed within 3-5 working days.

Travel/health insurance is a mandatory requirement for Umrah visa issuance under Saudi regulations. This is usually bundled into the Umrah package price, but customers should confirm coverage details with their consultant before travel.

Malaysia visit visa/eNTRI requirements include a passport valid for 6 months, passport photo, confirmed return ticket, hotel booking, and proof of sufficient funds. Many nationalities can apply online for an eNTRI or eVisa, typically processed within 3-5 working days.

Qatar visit visa requirements include a passport valid for at least 6 months, passport photo, confirmed hotel booking, return ticket, and bank statement. Many nationalities are eligible for visa-on-arrival or an online e-Visa, typically processed within 24-72 hours.
